findings.title: Asset rows remain below the viewport
findings.visible_description: Dashboard total, empty history axes/range controls and a promotion are visible. The My assets heading, Add networks and layout controls appear at the lower edge; no asset rows/cards are visible.

recapture.action: Scroll the asset container fully into view and capture at least one complete row/card with prices/actions; include layout controls in a second capture if necessary.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Fee and rewards are uncalculated or collapsed
findings.visible_description: Stake ETH shows an empty amount field, crypto/fiat input toggle, fractions/Max, a Maximum fee row reading To be calculated, activation timeline and a collapsed Estimated rewards section.

recapture.action: Enter a harmless QA amount without submitting; expand fee details and estimated rewards, wait for local calculation, then capture the form. If the mock cannot calculate them, keep the state explicitly uncalculated.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Reward estimate is not displayed
findings.visible_description: Unstake ETH shows a populated amount, fractions/Max and Rewards quick-select, a calculated maximum fee, deactivation timing and a later claim step. No separate estimated reward result is visible.
findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Solana fee value is not calculated
findings.visible_description: Stake SOL shows an empty amount, fractions/Max, Network fee (including rent) reading To be calculated, activation/reward timeline and a collapsed Estimated rewards section; Continue is disabled.

recapture.action: Enter a harmless QA amount without submitting; expand fee details and estimated rewards, wait for local calculation, then capture the form. If the mock cannot calculate them, keep the state explicitly uncalculated.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Voting is explained but no vote form is shown
findings.visible_description: Tron provider consent explains representative voting, retained ownership, provider terms and transaction-ID processing, followed by an unchecked acknowledgement and disabled Confirm. This image does not show allocation or a completed vote.

recapture.action: Reach the separate Vote step using a suitable local frozen-resource fixture; capture representative allocation without submitting.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: USDT vault row is outside the viewport
findings.visible_description: Earn shows staking opportunities and the beginning of DeFi Yield: the ETH vault row is complete, the USDC row is clipped, and the USDT vault row is not visible. The three-vault catalog is established separately by the initial opportunity capture and fixture source.

recapture.action: Scroll the USDT opportunity row fully into view and capture the complete Yield table, using more than one viewport if required.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Buy country picker does not directly verify Sell residence
findings.visible_description: Buy opens a Country of residence modal with a search field and a scrollable country subset. This capture is from Buy and does not directly demonstrate the same control in Sell.

recapture.action: Open Sell, then its residence selector, and record a separate capture if Sell-specific visual evidence is wanted.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Sell fraction controls are not visible
findings.visible_description: Sell shows source asset/account, crypto/fiat amount inputs, source balance, payout currency and residence. The fraction/Max controls are not visible in this idle screenshot.

recapture.action: Hover the source amount section or focus its fraction button before capture: source CSS intentionally sets opacity to zero until section hover/focus. Capture 25%, 50% and Max without submitting.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Swap fraction controls are not visible
findings.visible_description: Swap shows source/destination selectors, reverse-direction control, amounts and fiat references, source balance and receive account. Fraction/Max controls are not visible in this idle screenshot.

recapture.action: Hover the source amount section or focus its fraction button before capture: source CSS intentionally sets opacity to zero until section hover/focus. Capture 25%, 50% and Max without submitting.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Analytics, log and reset are below the image
findings.visible_description: Application settings show auto-eject, localization and labeling. The Color scheme row appears at the bottom; analytics, Show log, Reset app and app version are outside this viewport.

recapture.action: Scroll the Application section into view and capture the full analytics row.
Capture the Show log entry without opening account-containing logs.
Capture the reset entry and app version without executing another reset.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

findings.title: Safety action is clipped and Check device is absent
findings.visible_description: Device settings show backup checking, passphrase-wallet toggle, firmware version/type/language and the complete PIN toggle. Only the Safety checks label and upper edge of its Change button are visible; Check device is below the viewport.

recapture.action: Scroll the full Security block into view and capture Safety checks plus its action.
Scroll the authenticity entry fully into view and capture without initiating a hardware authenticity claim.

findings.interpretation: Original observations and images are preserved. This correction concerns visible PNG evidence only; it does not invalidate separately recorded interaction or source evidence.

cross_context_rule: A Buy country modal is not a direct Sell observation. Shared implementation evidence and separately reached states remain distinct. UI entry points and empty states do not establish successful transactions.
